Example: It is shocking that some people still live in bondage in the twenty-first century.

Example: People across the country donated food and clothing to the victims of the flood.

1. The chipmunk evaded the cat by scrambling up a tree.

Meaning: adj. A large number; very many.
Example: The bus makes numerous stops before it leaves us at school.

Meaning:
n. 1. A particular time.
n. 2. A special event.
Example:
1. I recognized Ranesha at once because we had met on a previous occasion.
2. My grandparents' anniversary party was a fun occasion for the whole family.

Example: Moin, my best friend, will oppose me in the chess tournament.

Example: The law now prohibits smoking in many public places.

Meaning:
v. 1. To follow in order to capture; to chase.
v. 2. To seek actively; to carry on with.
Example:
1. Police pursued the stolen car in a high-speed chase across town.
2. Do you intend to pursue a career in medicine?

Meaning: v. To make less worried or fearful; to comfort.
Example: I was nervous before the recital, but my piano teacher reassured me.

Meaning: adj. Not wanting to do something; unwilling.
Example: We were reluctant to leave our warm beds when we saw the ice on the windows.

Meaning:
adj. 1. Excellent of its kind.
adj. 2. Higher in position or rank.
n. A person of higher rank.
Example:
adj. 1. Margot made the team because she is a superior runner.
adj. 2. A general is superior to a sergeant in the army.
n. I reported to my superior as soon as I returned to work.

Meaning: v. To want very badly; to be filled with longing.
Example: Dorothy told the Wizard of Oz that she yearned to be back in Kansas.
